BUSINESS IT SERVICES

IT asset retirement and disposal coordination.

IT asset retirement covers taking equipment out of service, recording ownership and arranging appropriate data handling and disposition. HeyDock can scope decommissioning and coordinate the required disposal route. Collection, sanitisation and recycling obligations are confirmed with the responsible delivery organisations.

Discuss requirementsExplore services

SERVICE EXPLAINED

What does this service involve?

Retirement starts before a device leaves the site. Establish what it contains, whether data must be retained and who can authorise its release. A disposal project should maintain traceability from the asset list to the final evidence rather than treating collection as completion.

The engagement starts by identifying the business outcome, existing responsibilities and the changes you authorise. HeyDock then confirms suitable delivery capacity, the working window and the evidence needed to complete the task. Related licences, hardware, subscriptions and specialist services are included only where the proposal says so.

PRACTICAL SCOPE

What can be included?

The final statement of work identifies the tasks that apply to your environment.

Inventory and release approval

Match serial numbers, ownership and retention decisions. Check leases, finance arrangements and vendor return obligations before assuming an asset may be disposed of.

Data handling and chain of custody

Agree the sanitisation or destruction method, responsible party, transport controls and evidence required. Do not release equipment without an authorised process for the information it holds.

Final records

Reconcile collected assets with the agreed list, record exceptions and retain the relevant destruction or recycling evidence. The exact certifications and documentation depend on the chosen delivery route.

EXAMPLE REQUIREMENT

How a project might work.

An office closure may combine asset recovery, data retention and equipment disposal. Separating reuse, return and disposal items helps prevent serviceable or leased equipment entering the wrong stream.

PLANNING AND COST

What affects the scope and price?

Cost depends on the number of users, devices or sites; technical complexity; access requirements; delivery hours; travel; and the work needed before and after implementation. Provide relevant system versions and existing supplier responsibilities so the quotation can distinguish labour from licences, equipment and recurring charges.

For a well-defined task, a visit or project quotation may be appropriate. Where important dependencies are unknown, a paid assessment can produce a better implementation scope. Any response, attendance or recovery target must be explicitly agreed; requesting a service does not create an immediate support commitment.

COMMON QUESTIONS

IT asset retirement and disposal coordination FAQs

Are you a certified recycling or destruction provider?+

No specific waste-carrier, recycling or destruction certification is claimed here. The necessary provider credentials and process must be verified before work.

Can disposal be combined with a refresh project?+

Yes, where collection, data handling, ownership and reporting are included in the approved scope.

What information should we include in an enquiry?+

Describe the objective, location, affected systems, preferred timing and existing support arrangements. Do not send passwords or sensitive business records in the enquiry form.
